component.name: Media Studio
component.summary: Local media conversion studio for KDE Dolphin

description.p: Media Studio converts video, audio, and image files with reproducible profiles and verified output receipts. The standalone Flatpak keeps conversion data inside the sandbox and provides a terminal workflow for file-based media jobs.
Native installation adds KDE Dolphin service menus and user-systemd watch-folders. Those host integrations are intentionally not part of the strict sandbox package.

ul.li: Video, audio, image, remux, and target-size profiles
FFmpeg and FFprobe verification with full decode checks
Optional VAAPI and NVENC profiles when the host exposes the encoder
Atomic outputs, checksums, job state, and failure diagnostics

description.p: Fixed release subject manifests and completed the signed provenance pipeline.
Added standalone sandbox metadata, offline build inputs, and signed build provenance.
